summary: Transforms vertex-buffer data through the D3D device using the object's stored position and Euler-angle inputs, then clears the transform inputs, recomputes the bounding box, and allocates a fresh 8-element structure. Runs once, guarded by the 0x4000000 done flag in the flags word at this+0x14. Per-vertex work iterates over the element count at this+0x118 with array base at this+0x11C, branching on flags bit 0x800000 (mask global unk_800000 at 0x00800000) between a 16-DWORD and a 12-DWORD vertex stride.

local_names.v24: local 10-DWORD float struct holding the rotation matrix
local_names.v25: 64-byte scratch buffer passed to the device transform calls
local_names.a2: flag byte; bit 0x4 ORs 0x8000 onto the element's referenced object
